'''Jariat Rega''' was a [[human]] [[Jedi Master]] who served on Master [[Vernestra Rwoh]]'s Jedi team that traveled to [[Khofar]] and [[Brendok]] in [[132 BBY]] following the murders of four Jedi.<ref name="TA" />

Rega was only recently a Jedi Master when Master Vernestra Rwoh asked her to join him on a mission. Rega admired Vernestra and had read about her adventures in the Jedi Archives. She hoped to make a good impression on Master Vernestra.<ref name="VG" />

Rega joined Vernestra's team aboard the [[Cantaros]] to investigate what had happened to Master [[Sol]]'s team on Khofar. After burying the fallen Jedi there, they traveled to Brendok, where Vernestra also found Master Sol dead. The other Jedi found [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] with her memory stripped.<ref name="TA" />
